fit.sheet: Kingbright APT1608SURCK data sheet, DSAD0926 Rev V.22A (04/08/2023)
fit.figure: Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage (page 3), read from the PDF's vector drawing
fit.method: IS, N and RS by least squares on V = N·Vt·ln(I/IS) + RS·I (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode, Vt at 27 °C) over every other curve point, the curve's last point always included; BV 5 V, IBV 10 µA: the sheet's reverse current limit at 5 V
fit.note: The figure is linear and starts near 2 mA; below that the fit follows the diode equation, not the sheet
